meta.title: US App Store in-app purchase prices (USD) of six top match-3 / blast games

statusLegend.FACT: seen directly on the cited source on checkedOn (App Store page / Apple catalog API, or the game's own help page)
statusLegend.REPORTED: secondary source (wiki, analyst, newsletter, forum, tracker); may be older than checkedOn
statusLegend.ESTIMATE: my own inference or arithmetic; not seen on any source

meta.method: Each App Store page was read twice on 2026-10-23: the web page (apps.apple.com, 'In-App Purchases' list) and Apple's catalog API view 'top-in-app-purchasables' (via the Firecrawl apps-apple-com provider; source_url https://apps.apple.com/api/apps/v1/catalog/us/apps/<id>?...&views=top-in-app-purchasables). Apple shows only the top 10 IAPs per app (the API flags in_app_purchases_truncated=true for every game), so the full SKU ladder is not public. For five games both reads gave the same 10 items; for Toy Blast they gave two different sets, both are listed.
meta.caveat: Item names on the store rarely say what is inside. Contents come from secondary sources where found; otherwise contents is null.

puzzleGenre.keyLine: Most revenue in puzzle games comes from LiveOps-tied special offers in the $6-15 range; items at $50+ rarely make the top purchases.
